ESPN Sunday Night NFL was one of the many football games released back in the day. It features all 28 official NFL teams and their respective logos, but doesn't feature a license from the NFLPA, so there are no actual players names in the game.

There are four different game modes to choose from: Playoffs, Single Game, Season and another season mode that lets the player act out the 1994 NFL season schedule. It also had variable weather conditions that the players on the field would react to and a battery back-up to save games. It also featured Chris Berman, who not only graced the front cover but also gives commentary as well.

ESPN Sunday Night NFL fue uno de los muchos juegos de fútbol americano lanzados en su época. Incluye los 28 equipos oficiales de la NFL y sus respectivos logotipos, pero no cuenta con licencia de la NFLPA, así que no aparecen los nombres reales de los jugadores.

Hay cuatro modos de juego: Playoffs, Partido individual, Temporada y otro modo de temporada que permite recrear el calendario de la temporada 1994 de la NFL. También tenía condiciones climáticas variables a las que reaccionaban los jugadores en el campo, y una batería de respaldo para guardar partidas. Además, contaba con Chris Berman, quien no solo aparecía en la portada sino que también ofrecía comentarios.

This game is the next-gen update of NFL Quarterback Club.

Every team from the 1996 NFL season is shown here, with real player numbers and stats. 32 offensive plays and 16 defensive plays are available as you play. Options include setting quarter lengths, from one to 15 minutes, and selecting your mode of play: Preseason, Playoffs, or a full Season, in which you play 18 games towards the goal of the Super Bowl.

Este juego es la actualización de nueva generación de NFL Quarterback Club.

Aquí aparecen todos los equipos de la temporada 1996 de la NFL, con números y estadísticas reales de los jugadores. Durante el partido hay 32 jugadas ofensivas y 16 defensivas disponibles. Las opciones incluyen ajustar la duración de los cuartos, de uno a 15 minutos, y elegir el modo de juego: Pretemporada, Playoffs o una temporada completa, en la que juegas 18 partidos rumbo a la Super Bowl.

Playcalling expert John Madden again licenses Electronic Arts' flagship football simulation. New features for 1998 include more advanced Quarterback functions such as the ability to play lob passes and adjust timing patterns, and more instinctive AI features to adjust as the match goes on. Squad features have also been advanced, with the opportunity to create plays and trade them.

Gameplay is much the same as the other editions, with the full season on offer as well as playoffs and the Superbowl. Everything is presented TV-style, with play-by-play analysis and reports. The contemporary NFL teams are joined by great squads of the past.

El experto en jugadas John Madden vuelve a prestar su nombre al simulador de fútbol insignia de Electronic Arts. Las novedades para 1998 incluyen funciones más avanzadas para el mariscal de campo, como lanzar pases globo y ajustar los patrones de tiempo, además de una IA más intuitiva que se adapta a medida que avanza el partido. También se han mejorado las funciones de plantilla, con la posibilidad de crear jugadas y cambiarlas con otros equipos.

La jugabilidad es muy similar a la de las otras ediciones, con la temporada completa disponible, además de los playoffs y la Super Bowl. Todo se presenta al estilo televisivo, con análisis y reportajes jugada a jugada. A los equipos contemporáneos de la NFL se suman grandes plantillas del pasado.

criteria.text: Plantillas y modos básicos, menos opciones que las versiones 3D.
Controles simples de 16 bits, jugable pero limitado.
Edición distinta en estilo, mismo juego base.
Contenido completo con más opciones de configuración.
Aceleración 3D y mayor resolución, pero puede dar problemas en sistemas modernos.
Mando cómodo y guardado en tarjeta.
3D estable y sin problemas de compatibilidad.

fields.value: An NFL football game for the Super Nintendo and Nintendo Game Boy developed by Konami. It is one of the earlier NFL games to use a dynamic camera that turns around to follows whichever side is playing offense.

Juego de fútbol americano de la NFL para Super Nintendo y Game Boy, desarrollado por Konami. Es uno de los primeros juegos de la NFL que usan una cámara dinámica que gira para seguir al equipo que tiene el ataque.

Do you have the courage to be an NFL quarterback? The same folks that brought you TUROK have turned their attentions to the gridiron and have brought great graphics, realistic action, and lots of options to the sport. With full licenses from the NFL and its athletes, the game has all of the teams and players, plus perfect replications of logos and stadiums. Just to assure that the artificial intelligence was high and the gameplay realistic, the developers coaxed Brett Favre into designing some of the plays.

¿Tienes el valor de ser mariscal de campo de la NFL? Los mismos creadores de TUROK han puesto su atención en el campo de fútbol americano y han aportado gráficos excelentes, acción realista y muchas opciones para el deporte. Con licencias completas de la NFL y sus atletas, el juego incluye todos los equipos y jugadores, además de réplicas perfectas de logotipos y estadios. Para asegurar una IA de alto nivel y una jugabilidad realista, los desarrolladores convencieron a Brett Favre para diseñar algunas de las jugadas.
NFL Blitz takes the idea of a normal football video game and turns it on its head with fewer players, bigger hits, and lots of personality.
NFL Blitz toma la idea de un videojuego de fútbol americano normal y le da la vuelta, con menos jugadores, golpes más fuertes y mucha personalidad.

criteria.text: Modos arcade completos y hasta cuatro jugadores.
Controles ágiles y partidas de cuatro jugadores.
Depende del mando y la compatibilidad actual.
Mejor resolución, pero errores en sistemas modernos.
Contenido casi idéntico al de N64.
Buen control pero menos jugadores con un solo mando.
Tiempos de carga y gráficos más suaves.
Descarga digital con modo en línea, menos modos.
Reinicio con otro equilibrio, no es el original.
Descarga digital con modo en línea, menos modos.
Reinicio con otro equilibrio, no es el original.

fields.value: The #1 football game on N64 just got a whole lot better! All 31 NFL teams, 3D rendered stadiums and over 1,500 players. Authentic team playbooks like the 49ers West Coast Defense and Steelers Ground Attack. All-new artificial intelligence developed by New York Jets offensive coordinator Charlie Weis. 250 all-new motion captured animations. Award-winning hi-rez graphics. Create your own players, coaches, teams, uniforms and playbooks!

¡El juego de fútbol americano número 1 de N64 mejora todavía más! Incluye los 31 equipos de la NFL, estadios renderizados en 3D y más de 1500 jugadores. Libros de jugadas auténticos, como la Defensa de Costa Oeste de los 49ers y el Ataque por Tierra de los Steelers. Inteligencia artificial completamente nueva, desarrollada por Charlie Weis, coordinador ofensivo de los New York Jets. 250 animaciones nuevas con captura de movimiento. Gráficos en alta resolución galardonados. ¡Crea tus propios jugadores, entrenadores, equipos, uniformes y libros de jugadas!

It's back and it's better than ever! NFL Blitz 2000 adds 4-player support, new offensive and defensive plays, realistic weather conditions, new stadiums and a Tournament mode! Customize offensive and defensive plays to your liking. Call audibles at the line of scrimmage. You've got control now! Passing made easy with new "Blitz Passing" for one-touch long bombs! "ON-FIRE" mode gives super power performance to your players! With non-stop action and a "pick-it-up-and-play" learning curve, NFL BLITZ 2000 is THE game for every football fan!

¡Ha vuelto y es mejor que nunca! NFL Blitz 2000 añade soporte para 4 jugadores, nuevas jugadas ofensivas y defensivas, condiciones climáticas realistas, nuevos estadios y un modo Torneo. ¡Personaliza las jugadas ofensivas y defensivas a tu gusto! Cambia las jugadas en la línea de scrimmage. ¡Ahora tienes el control! Pasar es más fácil con el nuevo «Blitz Passing», para lanzar bombas largas con un solo toque. El modo «ON-FIRE» da un rendimiento de superpoder a tus jugadores. Con acción sin pausa y una curva de aprendizaje de «recógelo y juega», ¡NFL BLITZ 2000 es EL juego para todo aficionado al fútbol americano!

criteria.text: Depende del mando y la compatibilidad.

fields.value: NFL Quarterback Club 2000 is here! Featuring 3rd generation ultra high-rez graphics for incredible NFL realism, over 1,200 new motion captured animations, all-new Pin Point Passing for unprecedented control, new player models with real-life faces, eye black and breathe strips. Choose from 31 team-specific playbooks or create your own. Replay key moments of all 33 Super Bowls with authentic game stats. Total team management - draft, sign, trade, release, create players.

¡Llegó NFL Quarterback Club 2000! Con gráficos de alta resolución ultra de tercera generación para un realismo increíble de la NFL, más de 1200 animaciones nuevas con captura de movimiento, el nuevo Pin Point Passing para un control sin precedentes, nuevos modelos de jugadores con rostros reales, pintura negra bajo los ojos y tiras nasales. Elige entre 31 libros de jugadas específicos de cada equipo o crea los tuyos. Revive momentos clave de las 33 Super Bowls con estadísticas auténticas. Gestión total del equipo: draft, firma, intercambio, corte y creación de jugadores.

Mind-blowing NFL simulation returns with the next installment of this popular, detailed football extravaganza. With full licenses from the NFL and its athletes, the game has all 31teams and 1500 players, plus perfect replication of logos and stadiums. The game’s five modes include Exhibition, Playoff, Season, Practice, and Simulation. Exhibition lets you take the field as any current NFL team, All-Star lineup, or Super Bowl team since 1967. All of the modes keep more comprehensive stats than you could ever hope for, and you can set up a Season to include preseason action, hot-cold streaks, and player development. Not only that, you can create players, teams, playbooks (with up 128 offensive plays), and profiles of chosen formations and pass-run ratios. There’s even a historical mode that allows you to tap into classic games of yesteryear, featuring teams that date back to 1967. ESPN’s Mike Patrick and Randy Cross chime in with commentary, and Brett Favre has returned yet again to add his insight. Throw a dozen camera angles into the mix, and you’ve got yourself a football game.

La impresionante simulación de la NFL regresa con una nueva entrega de este popular y detallado espectáculo de fútbol americano. Con licencias completas de la NFL y sus atletas, el juego incluye los 31 equipos y 1500 jugadores, además de réplicas perfectas de logotipos y estadios. Sus cinco modos de juego son Exhibición, Playoff, Temporada, Práctica y Simulación. Exhibición te permite jugar con cualquier equipo actual de la NFL, con una alineación All-Star o con un equipo campeón de Super Bowl desde 1967. Todos los modos llevan estadísticas más completas de las que podrías imaginar, y puedes configurar una temporada que incluya pretemporada, rachas de buena y mala forma, y desarrollo de jugadores. Además, puedes crear jugadores, equipos, libros de jugadas (con hasta 128 jugadas ofensivas) y perfiles de formaciones y proporciones de pase y carrera. También hay un modo histórico que te permite revivir partidos clásicos de antaño, con equipos desde 1967. Mike Patrick y Randy Cross, de ESPN, aportan comentarios, y Brett Favre vuelve a ofrecer su perspectiva. Con una docena de ángulos de cámara, tienes un gran juego de fútbol americano.

All of the big plays and bone-crunching hits of the arcade game can be put in the palm of your hand with NFL BLITZ 2001. As with all BLITZ games, football has been reduced to a high-scoring seven-on-seven affair. Pick your squad from any of the 31 NFL teams and go at it in the Season or Arcade modes. Arcade mode has you challenge all of the teams in the league to a game, while Season mode puts you through the paces of a 16-game season, the playoffs, and a chance to win the Super Bowl. No matter what mode you play, you won't miss a second of the action thanks to the multiple camera angles that are available. Whenever there is a great play, the digitized voice of the announcer will let you know, and you will be treated to a full-motion video sequence. Get into the game with NFL BLITZ 2001.

Todas las grandes jugadas y los golpes demoledores del juego arcade caben ahora en la palma de tu mano con NFL BLITZ 2001. Como en todos los juegos BLITZ, el fútbol americano se reduce a un encuentro de siete contra siete con muchos puntos. Elige tu equipo entre los 31 equipos de la NFL y juega en los modos Temporada o Arcade. El modo Arcade te reta a enfrentarte a todos los equipos de la liga, mientras que el modo Temporada te lleva por una temporada de 16 partidos, los playoffs y la oportunidad de ganar la Super Bowl. Sin importar el modo, no te perderás ni un segundo de acción gracias a los múltiples ángulos de cámara disponibles. Cada vez que haya una gran jugada, la voz digitalizada del anunciador te lo hará saber, y disfrutarás de una secuencia de video completa. ¡Métete de lleno en el juego con NFL BLITZ 2001!

Madden NFL 07 is the seventeenth installment of the Madden NFL series. This version introduces some new tricks, updates some features, and brings depth to some game modes from previous Madden titles.

The 07 game focuses on the Running Back by giving you lead blocker controls. After selecting a running play, you can cycle through offensive players to open up gaps. New evasive maneuvers are controlled with a separate stick to elude defenders, along with new juking and spinning maneuvers.

Start a career with your favorite NFL team, draft the players, call the plays, and lead your team to a dynasty. Or, make your own player and guide him on and off the field through his entire career starting with the draft. If you do not want to mess with all the options and features you can simply sit down for a quick game.

The NFL Blitz 20-02 incarnation promises deeper gameplay, more animations, better AI, more mini-games, and even harder hits. Still focusing on its roots of hard-hitting football action with no rules whatsoever, the game hopes to hit the consoles as hard as its players hit each other.
NFL Quarterback Club II is a Sports game, developed by Condor and published by Acclaim Japan, which was released in 1995.
NFL Quarterback Club II es un juego deportivo desarrollado por Condor y publicado por Acclaim Japan, lanzado en 1995.
Play and manage football matches between real NFL teams, featuring the latest player lineups of 2013!

criteria.text: Casi completo, extras con la tableta.

NFL QB Club 2002 is a football video game developed and published by Acclaim Entertainment under their Acclaim Sports banner. It is the final game in Acclaim's NFL Quarterback Club series. Some of the game's key features are:

NFL Quarterback Challenge mode, featuring four head-to-head events: Speed and Mobility, Accuracy, Long Distance Throw and Read & Recognition.
Unlock retired players like John Elway, Dan Marino, Steve Young, Jim Kelly and Phil Simms
31 NFL clubs and over 1500 NFL players.
Play-by-play from Kevin Harlan and color commentary from Bill Maas.
Player models feature blinking eyes, jaw motions, facial expressions and removable helmets.
Player injuries, penalties and weather conditions affect season play and individual player performance.
5 modes of play: Season, Exhibition, Challenge Mode, Playoffs, and Pro Bowl

NFL QB Club 2002 es un videojuego de fútbol americano desarrollado y publicado por Acclaim Entertainment bajo su sello Acclaim Sports. Es el último juego de la serie NFL Quarterback Club de Acclaim. Algunas de sus características principales son:

Modo NFL Quarterback Challenge, con cuatro eventos cara a cara: Velocidad y movilidad, Precisión, Lanzamiento de larga distancia y Lectura y reconocimiento.
Desbloqueo de jugadores retirados como John Elway, Dan Marino, Steve Young, Jim Kelly y Phil Simms.
31 equipos de la NFL y más de 1500 jugadores.
Narración jugada a jugada de Kevin Harlan y comentarios de Bill Maas.
Los modelos de jugadores tienen ojos que parpadean, movimientos de mandíbula, expresiones faciales y cascos desmontables.
Las lesiones, las penalizaciones y las condiciones climáticas afectan la temporada y el rendimiento individual de los jugadores.
5 modos de juego: Temporada, Exhibición, Modo Desafío, Playoffs y Pro Bowl.

criteria.text: Mejor imagen y tiempos de carga cortos.
Algo más borroso y con más carga.

fields.value: NFL Street is a series of sports video games developed by EA Tiburon and published by Electronic Arts. It combines the talent and big names of the NFL with the atmosphere of street football

NFL Street 2 is the second game in EA's arcade football series. Players try to become the world's best urban footballer by conquering other teams using several gravity-defying tricks like up-the-wall passes, off-the-wall catches, and highlight-reel wall jukes.

NFL 2K is an American football video game series developed by Visual Concepts and published by Sega.[1] Based on the National Football League, the series was originally exclusive to Sega's Dreamcast video game console. As the foremost "2K" title, it marked the beginning of a running athletics series that eventually led to the spinning off of 2K's sports publishing business under the name of 2K Sports.

Upon the Dreamcast's discontinuation, the series continued to be published for other sixth generation game systems and became the chief competitor of EA Sports's Madden NFL series. However, after the competitively priced NFL 2K5 significantly reduced sales of that year's Madden release, EA signed an exclusivity deal with the NFL that made Madden NFL the only series allowed to use NFL team and player names.

After losing the NFL license, Visual Concepts made a brief return to developing football games with the release of All-Pro Football 2K8, which featured former NFL players.
Play and manage football matches between real NFL teams, featuring the latest player lineups of 2009!

Madden NFL 10 also lets you take your fight online with an all-new Online Franchise mode, complete with 32 teams, NFL-style drafts and a custom league webpage. Add to that the most immersive broadcast presentation to date, and Madden NFL 10 gives you everything you see on Sundays, minus the grass.

Madden NFL 11 re-energizes the game of football with a fun and exhilarating experience to ignite the passion of every NFL fan. Whether you’re rekindling an old rivalry, putting your spin on the best moments of 2009, or building the ultimate dynasty in Franchise mode, Madden NFL 11 makes every day feel like Sunday. Experience the passion for football shared by Gus Johnson and Cris Collinsworth as they call the action on the field. Fight for fumbles, design your own plays, and feel what it's like to be an NFL superstar with Madden NFL 11, the ultimate NFL experience on PlayStation Portable.
Play and manage football matches between real NFL teams, featuring the latest player lineups of 2012!

NFL Quarterback Club 97 is an American football video game released in 1996. The game was released on the PlayStation, Sega Saturn, and DOS systems. The game was also released in Japan on the Saturn. The game's cover features former Miami Dolphins quarterback Dan Marino.

NFL Quarterback Club 97 es un videojuego de fútbol americano lanzado en 1996. Salió para PlayStation, Sega Saturn y sistemas DOS, y también se lanzó en Japón para Saturn. En la portada aparece el exmariscal de campo de los Miami Dolphins Dan Marino.

This is the first installment in the NFL GAMEDAY series, and it has all the players, teams, stadiums, stats, and injuries that you see in the real NFL in fact, this game is so realistic it could even fool the most diehard fans into thinking they're watching a game on TV, not playing one. There is a wide variety of offensive and defensive moves you can use to make things easier, including dives, spins, hurdles, jukes, and stiff arms on offense; and dives, jumps, forearm bashes, and swim moves on defense. Basically, if you've seen it done in the real NFL, then chances are you'll see it in NFL GAMEDAY. Things like long snap counts, men in motion, and defensive stunts can all be found in the game, giving you an NFL experience like no other. You can also take on a friend in versus mode, and see who is the king of the gridiron.

Es la primera entrega de la serie NFL GAMEDAY e incluye todos los jugadores, equipos, estadios, estadísticas y lesiones que se ven en la NFL real. De hecho, el juego es tan realista que podría engañar incluso a los aficionados más fieles, haciéndoles creer que ven un partido por televisión en lugar de jugarlo. Hay una gran variedad de movimientos ofensivos y defensivos para facilitar las cosas: en ataque, zambullidas, giros, saltos sobre obstáculos, fintas y empujones con el brazo rígido; en defensa, zambullidas, saltos, golpes con el antebrazo y movimientos de nado. En pocas palabras, si lo has visto hacer en la NFL real, es muy probable que lo encuentres en NFL GAMEDAY. También hay elementos como los conteos largos antes del snap, los jugadores en movimiento y los stunts defensivos, para una experiencia de la NFL como ninguna otra. Además, puedes enfrentarte a un amigo en el modo versus y decidir quién es el rey del campo.

With action that's even rougher than the XFL (believe it), NFL FULL CONTACT has all of the NFL teams, players, and schedules with an extra dose of aggression. Featuring more than 1,500 motion-captured players and stats based on the 1995 regular season, the game lets you pull from an 80-play offensive book. Play a single game or jump directly to the Playoffs, facing off against a randomly selected bracket of teams. Simple controls allow you to see which buttons will get the ball to which receivers, and four different audibles let you change plays at the last second. A realistic PA announcer adds a touch of stadium ambiance, while a password system ensures that your Playoff progress won't be held up by annoyances like work, school, or dinner. Fully flexible camera angles provide detailed coverage, the defensive AI is high, and the action is truly hard-hitting. If you like your football with a little extra oomph, you've come to the right place.

Con una acción aún más brusca que la de la XFL (créanlo), NFL FULL CONTACT incluye todos los equipos, jugadores y calendarios de la NFL con una dosis extra de agresividad. Cuenta con más de 1500 jugadores capturados por movimiento y estadísticas basadas en la temporada regular de 1995, y te permite elegir entre un libro ofensivo de 80 jugadas. Puedes jugar un partido suelto o ir directamente a los playoffs, enfrentándote a un cuadro de equipos seleccionado al azar. Los controles sencillos te muestran qué botones llevan el balón a qué receptores, y cuatro audibles diferentes te permiten cambiar la jugada en el último momento. Un anunciador de estadio realista añade ambiente, mientras que un sistema de contraseñas garantiza que tu progreso en los playoffs no se vea interrumpido por molestias como el trabajo, la escuela o la cena. Los ángulos de cámara totalmente flexibles ofrecen una cobertura detallada, la IA defensiva es alta y la acción es realmente contundente. Si te gusta el fútbol americano con un poco más de potencia, has llegado al lugar indicado.

Sony's football franchise carries on with another intense NFL match-up. In addition to all the features you expect from this series, GameDay '97 also includes new options like season-ending injuries, a full-fledged draft, more statistics, and the ability to create players. You'll also get expanded camera control, allowing you to place the camera at any angle. Every NFL team (over 1,500 players) and all stadiums are also included, letting you put your favorite team on the filed for some intense NFL action. But where the game really shines is in the gameplay. The control is deadly accurate, meaning diving catches are a distinct possibility. Making one-handed grabs, diving into the end zone, and even running out of bounds and slamming into the coach are also possible. And with a multitap seven of your friends can get in on the action.

La franquicia de fútbol de Sony continúa con otro intenso enfrentamiento de la NFL. Además de todas las características que se esperan de esta serie, GameDay '97 incluye nuevas opciones como lesiones que terminan la temporada, un draft completo, más estadísticas y la posibilidad de crear jugadores. También tendrás un control de cámara ampliado, que te permite colocarla en cualquier ángulo. Todos los equipos de la NFL (más de 1500 jugadores) y todos los estadios están incluidos, para que puedas poner a tu equipo favorito en el campo y vivir una intensa acción de la NFL. Pero donde el juego realmente brilla es en la jugabilidad. El control es letalmente preciso, lo que hace posibles las atrapadas en plancha. También puedes hacer atrapadas con una mano, lanzarte a la zona de anotación e incluso salirte del campo y estrellarte contra el entrenador. Y con un multitap, siete de tus amigos pueden unirse a la acción.

The world champion Denver Broncos approach the line-of-scrimmage, the quarterback takes the snap, he feigns left then delivers the delay hand-off to Terrell Davis, who skirts right, turns on the speed hitting the hole between the offensive tackle and the center and explodes into mid-field for a 23 yard gain. Well in this scenario, the quarterback is not the retired John Elway, but his replacement Bubby Brister, and the game is not a live broadcast but another go at 989 Studio's NFL GameDay 2000. The 2000 edition features more balanced plays, better CPU AI (including a pre-snap AI scheme), and more than 200 new motion captured animations.

Los campeones del mundo, los Denver Broncos, se acercan a la línea de scrimmage. El mariscal de campo recibe el snap, finge hacia la izquierda y entrega el balón con retraso a Terrell Davis, que se desvía por la derecha, acelera y se mete por el hueco entre el tackle ofensivo y el centro, y avanza hasta mitad de campo con una ganancia de 23 yardas. En este escenario, el mariscal de campo no es el retirado John Elway, sino su reemplazo, Bubby Brister, y el juego no es una transmisión en vivo, sino otra partida de NFL GameDay 2000 de 989 Studios. La edición 2000 presenta jugadas más equilibradas, una mejor IA de la CPU (incluido un esquema de IA previo al snap) y más de 200 nuevas animaciones con captura de movimiento.

NFL GameDay 2002 is the seventh video game in the NFL GameDay series. It was developed by 989 Sports and Red Zone Interactive and published Sony Computer Entertainment America for the PlayStation and the PlayStation 2 in 2001. On the cover is Donovan McNabb.

NFL GameDay 2002 es el séptimo videojuego de la serie NFL GameDay. Fue desarrollado por 989 Sports y Red Zone Interactive, y publicado por Sony Computer Entertainment America para PlayStation y PlayStation 2 en 2001. En la portada aparece Donovan McNabb.

criteria.text: Gráficos de PS1 y baja resolución.

fields.value: NFL GAMEDAY '98 is loaded with features like Preseason, Season, and Training Camp modes. You can also choose to play as a skill player, like wide receiver or fullback. And when you consider that you also get a play editor, a create-a-player feature, over 100 touchdown dances, and accurate player attributes, you'll realize why the GAMEDAY series is one of the best around. You can also take on your friends (up to eight with the multitap) in the Versus mode.

NFL GAMEDAY '98 incluye funciones como los modos Pretemporada, Temporada y Campo de entrenamiento. También puedes elegir jugar como un jugador de posición, por ejemplo receptor abierto o fullback. Y si consideras que además tienes un editor de jugadas, una función para crear jugadores, más de 100 bailes de touchdown y atributos de jugadores precisos, entenderás por qué la serie GAMEDAY es una de las mejores. También puedes enfrentarte a tus amigos (hasta ocho con multitap) en el modo Versus.

NFL GameDay 99[edit]
NFL GameDay 99 was the fourth game in the NFL GameDay series. It was released July 31, 1998 on the PlayStation, and August 31, 1998 on the PC, both by 989 Sports. On the cover is Terrell Davis.
NFL GameDay 99 fue el cuarto juego de la serie NFL GameDay. Salió el 31 de julio de 1998 para PlayStation y el 31 de agosto de 1998 para PC, ambos de 989 Sports. En la portada aparece Terrell Davis.
989 Sports takes another stab at NFL Blitz's dominance over the arcade football genre by adding more sim style playbook.
989 Sports vuelve a intentar arrebatarle a NFL Blitz el dominio del género de fútbol americano arcade, añadiendo un libro de jugadas de estilo más simulación.

NFL Xtreme is a licensed NFL game with 30 official teams and stadiums. Loosely simulating American football, games are played on a five-on-five format and an arcade approach is taken, with complete disregard for the official rules. Quarterbacks can easily throw 90-yard passes, defenders have hard-hitting tackling moves, and attackers can use spin or turbo to evade opponents, or flip over them. Late hits and pass interference are no problem, and you can even taunt and trash talk. To promote aggressiveness, opponents, when properly injured, can be out for an entire season.

The game modes includes exhibition matches, a regular season and play-offs. There are detailed statistics, and you can sign, release or even create new players to build your team. Highlights can be reviewed in the instant replay mode, and you can alter the weather type, difficulty level and player size in the options.

NFL Xtreme es un juego con licencia de la NFL que incluye 30 equipos y estadios oficiales. Simulando de manera libre el fútbol americano, los partidos se juegan en formato de cinco contra cinco con un enfoque arcade, sin ningún respeto por las reglas oficiales. Los mariscales de campo pueden lanzar pases de 90 yardas con facilidad, los defensas tienen movimientos de placaje muy contundentes, y los atacantes pueden usar giros o turbo para evadir a sus rivales o pasarlos por encima. Los golpes tardíos y las interferencias de pase no son problema, e incluso puedes provocar y lanzar insultos. Para fomentar la agresividad, los oponentes lesionados de forma adecuada pueden quedar fuera de toda una temporada.

Los modos de juego incluyen partidos de exhibición, una temporada regular y playoffs. Hay estadísticas detalladas, y puedes firmar, cortar o incluso crear jugadores nuevos para armar tu equipo. Las jugadas destacadas se pueden revisar en el modo de repetición instantánea, y en las opciones puedes cambiar el tipo de clima, el nivel de dificultad y el tamaño de los jugadores.

NFL GameDay 2005 was the tenth and final game in the NFL GameDay series, and unlike the last few GameDay video games, it was only available on the PlayStation console, and not on the PlayStation 2. It was released on August 1, 2004. On the cover is Derrick Brooks.

NFL Head Coach is a National Football League video game that was released on June 20, 2006 for the PlayStation 2, Xbox and PC. The game allows the player to control an NFL team and become the greatest coach in NFL history. It features then-Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Bill Cowher on the cover.

ESPN NFL 2K5 is an American football video game developed by Visual Concepts for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox consoles. Published by Sega Sports and the Sega Corporation, it is the sixth installment of the NFL 2K series and the last to use official NFL licensing until an unnamed sequel is released in 2021. Gameplay is presented as a live ESPN television broadcast and features the voices and digital likenesses of multiple ESPN on-air personalities.

The game was originally released on July 20, 2004. It was the last NFL 2K game to be released before Electronic Arts (EA) signed an exclusive rights agreement with the National Football League (NFL) to make 2K's rival Madden NFL series the only officially licensed NFL game and was also the last game still being developed by Sega.

Description of NFL Head Coach 09
EA's football coach simulator heads back to the gridiron in NFL Head Coach 09. With gameplay more akin to European-style "Soccer Manager" games than the Madden NFL franchise from which it spawned, the original NFL Head Coach generally received lukewarm reviews from critics. But after a one-year hiatus -- during which it presumably did a little TV and work spent some quality time with the family -- the franchise returns with a new focus on depth and realism. Once again the coach's livelihood depends on his approval rating, and everything gamers do, from win/loss record, to going for it on fourth down, to choosing whether to yell at the QB after a bad interception, will affect approval rating.

Key personnel decisions have been given an added sense of urgency with the new Live Event feature, which puts all trade, free agency, coaching, and contract negotiations up against a running timer. As in real life, the draft is the centerpiece of the NFL offseason, and gamers can prepare by scouting players in college all-star games, at the NFL combine, and during pro-day and individual workouts. Meanwhile, players can get running commentary on the lives and college careers of more than 20,000 unique draft prospects from NFL Network personality Adam Schefter. Other additions intended to increase realism include: Non-drafted free agent rookies, 75-man preseason rosters, trades involving future draft picks, a new wear and tear injury system, and 300 new sideline animations.

NFL Head Coach 09's online features allow gamers to upload created plays and download, rate, or view any play available. Two players can also go head-to-head in a quick test of coaching acumen. Offline, gamers can adjust their plays in the middle of a game and save the new formations, or create entire playbooks using the coach clipboard user interface. All created plays can then be exported and used in Madden NFL 09. ~ Christopher Brown, All Game Guide

Madden NFL 15 transforms you into your rival's worst nightmare with a new breed of defense built to challenge the best offenses in the NFL. An all-new intuitive tackling system and improved coverage logic make defense exciting and fun to play. Learn and hone your skills in the Gauntlet, an all-new mode in Skills Trainer that will take your new abilities through the ultimate test in intense conditions and challenges. Whether building your legacy in Connected Franchise or a dynasty in Ultimate Team, it's not just football, it's Madden Season!

Madden NFL 16 delivers all-new controls that allow you to dominate in the battle for air supremacy. New QB mechanics including body-relative throws, plus touch and roll out passes provide you with unprecedented depth and control while under center. Combined with a new risk/reward catch and pass-defend system, get ready for the biggest WOW moments in franchise history.

Take your team all the way in Madden NFL 17 with new and immersive features in the deepest Franchise mode to-date, putting you at the center of your team’s Championship run. Arm your team for gridiron glory on both sides of the ball with innovative ball carrier feedback cues, defender fake out mechanics and a new, authentic defensive AI system. Driven by the most balanced gameplay yet, along with fun and fresh ways to play modes such as Ultimate Team and Draft Champions, Madden NFL 17 is the most complete Madden…ever.

Madden NFL 19 takes a significant leap forward in terms of gameplay and control. Not only are there new ways to play, but Terrell Owens is back in Madden Ultimate Team. Get your popcorn ready and achieve gridiron greatness with T.O.

Feel like an NFL Superstar in Madden NFL 20. Be the Face of an NFL franchise where the decisions you make matter in your journey to become an NFL Superstar in ‘FACE OF THE FRANCHISE: QB1’. Feel the emotion, personality, and power of NFL Superstars with ‘SUPERSTAR X-FACTOR’, an all-new abilities progression system that reveals special abilities for today’s most exciting NFL Superstars heightening the level strategy and excitement in every game.

Go all out in Madden NFL 21 where a fearless new generation of rising NFL stars is poised to change the game. Packed with fresh new features and innovative gameplay enhancements, Madden NFL 21 delivers new levels of ingenuity and control developed to inspire creativity on and off the field.
